description: The open source AI coding agent, available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or web app
notes: OpenCode v2 CLI. Start it with the 'opencode2' command.
The 'opencode' command is left untouched for the v1 manifest in the main bucket, so v1 and v2 can coexist.
Upgrade with 'scoop update opencode-v2'. Do NOT run the built-in 'opencode2 upgrade': it only knows curl/npm/pnpm/bun/yarn/vp/brew and would replace the binary outside Scoop's control.
The official docs state Windows package managers are not supported; this manifest only wraps the official v2 binary from opencode.ai/files/bin.
